name: Divine Might: Cater
effects:

Conditional Cap Break: Level 1/2/4 with at least 2/3/5 Fire or Ice or Lightning Abilities in party, Level 5 with at least 5 Fire or Ice or Lightning Abilities & 2 En-Fire or En-Ice or En-Lightning members in party; Multiplier increases with each tier
